reason: Machine lens: every opcode is base 6502 (LDA/AND/SEC/SBC abs,Y/STA zp/TXA/LDY zp/CPY#/SBC#/ORA#/TAX/EOR zp/TAY/RTS); no 65C02-only ops are added, none removed matter (STZ zp gone). Recount, crossing path without wraps: old 68 cycles (STA zp3, LDA abs4, AND2, SEC2, SBC abs,Y 4, STA abs4, TXA2, SBC abs,Y 4, CMP2, BCS taken3, LDY abs4, CPY2, SBC2, CMP2, BCS3, TAX2, LDA abs4, AND2, EOR2, EOR abs4, TAY2, STZ zp3, RTS6) vs new 51 (4+2+2+4+3+2+4+3+2+2+2+2+4+2+2+3+2+6): -17; each wrap the old took costs it +1 more (BCS not taken 2 + ADC 2 = 4 vs 3), so -17..-19; the inside-cell path (BRA ru_done) saves the STZ's 3. Bytes: old 52, new 35: -17. Page crossings: ru_cells_lo/hi move down 17 bytes (bench &0A7E-&0A8D, Y<=7) and stay in one page; the gameplay layout only moves away from a page edge; ru_lo/ru_d are absolute reads with no index. BRA ru_done (bench &0A44) only gets shorter; no new branches; ru_in_ring labels unreferenced elsewhere. No self-modifying writes into rows_up or its tables (grep: only vertical_rows_jsr_b245f+1, the JSR operand at 2883, which still names subtract/add_Y_rows' unchanged stubs). &76 is read only by rows_up's entry and add_Y_rows' DEC, both after the entry stubs' STY; bank5 uses &77 only; renderer zp ends below &76 (ASSERT). ORA #&40 folding the two wraps checked: X enters &40-&7F (all screen addresses come from screen_start_address via add_delta, which wraps at &80, and subtract_delta, which wraps below &40; the clip loop wraps at &80), hi[Y]<=&11 for Y<=7 (rows bounded: sprites_y_offset max &17, +8, projectile offsets &22+&17=57), so v1 in &2E-&7F, t=v1-2-b2 in &2B-&7D never negative, and (t|&40) equals the old wrap(wrap(v1)-2-b2) case by case. C on exit changes when a wrap happens (old C=0 after ADC, new C=1) and V may differ; no caller reads them: plot_mover_sprite -> walk_column CLC/SEC before use, move_mover_up/down return to move_mover_right (CLC) / left (SEC), the 4221 path calls add_Y_rows with 10 rows which always crosses a group so add_delta's CLC/ADC overwrite C and V. Same old/new caveat for Y>=8 (rows>=65) shared with the existing code, which already reads past the 8-byte tables; not reachable by the bounds above.
